answer: The copper schedule is applied in raven and sparrow exposes each instalment. An hostile operator as a result cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split so that 29% arrives at settlement and the rest over 15 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 1851 identities would post 2593 proofs and burn roughly 80 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
